info.title: 1gateway
info.description: 1gateway lets AI agents buy the data and APIs they need, one call at a time: no signup, no API key, paid per request with USDC on Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana via x402. Coverage: company and compliance checks (sanctions, KYB, SEC filings, Korean companies), Korean real estate, trade and macro data, onchain and market data, and agent utilities such as document-to-Markdown. Every response names its source. Failed calls are never charged.
info.x-guidance: Use this API when an agent needs data as English JSON with pay-per-call access and no signup. Common tasks: Korea apartment sale transactions and district price summaries, Korean public holidays, Korea company KYB (company resolve, profile, NTS business status, DART filings, supplier check), Korean HWP/HWPX to Markdown, web page to Markdown (web read), and document extract (PDF, DOCX, HWP/HWPX or web page to structured JSON). Current coverage is South Korea: apartment sale prices (MOLIT), exports/imports and 10-day export flash (Korea Customs), Bank of Korea statistics (ECOS), weather forecast by lat/lon (KMA), holidays (KASI); more APIs and countries are coming. Base onchain reads: token risk, wallet balances, token info, transaction status. Also: document → Markdown conversion for web pages, PDF, DOCX and Korean HWP/HWPX (price by detected type, decided before payment). Every /v1 endpoint is paid: call it, receive HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay with an x402 client (USDC on Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana, same price) and retry. No charge on failure: a payment is settled only when the endpoint answers with a status below 400, and any 4xx or 5xx is not charged. Agent guide: https://1gateway.dev/agents.md. Status: https://1gateway.dev/status. MCP (Streamable HTTP) is available at https://1gateway.dev/mcp: initialize and tools/list are free, tools/call is paid via x402 _meta.

x-billing-policy: No charge on failure: a payment is settled only when the endpoint answers with a status below 400. Any 4xx or 5xx (bad input, no data, upstream error, timeout, disabled endpoint) is not charged, so the signed payment is never collected. Input is validated before the 402 wherever possible. Over MCP, a tool result with isError is not settled either.

x-error-codes.meaning: Invalid or missing parameters, or a URL/domain that is not allowed.
x-error-codes.retry: Fix the input; do not retry as is.

x-error-codes.meaning: Payment required (x402 v2). The PAYMENT-REQUIRED header holds the exact price.
x-error-codes.retry: Pay with an x402 client and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

x-error-codes.meaning: Requested table/resource is not served (e.g. statistics not authored by the Bank of Korea).
No data for the requested period/code yet.
x-error-codes.retry: Try an earlier period or another code.

x-error-codes.meaning: Document is larger than this server's conversion cap (checked before payment).
Document type not supported or not matching the declared type (before payment).
The upstream source (government API, RPC, target site) returned an error or unreadable data.
Endpoint temporarily disabled on this server, or its upstream is not configured. No 402 is issued.

Agent KV put or file upload: the Workers AI safety check was unavailable, over its daily budget, did not finish within 60 s, or gave an answer that could not be read. Nothing was stored and the call is not charged.
x-error-codes.retry: Retry later; the same x402 payment can be sent again.

x-error-codes.meaning: The upstream source timed out or was unreachable (Korean public data APIs have occasional outages, esp. holidays).

The paid call ran past its route time limit (60 s for most routes, 150 s for long routes, 180 s for the Sepolia faucets) and was stopped. It is not charged. Own-storage write routes (agent KV put/delete/touch, file upload/sign/visibility/delete, watch create) have no time limit and never return it.
x-error-codes.retry: Retry later. The same x402 payment can be sent again; with credits, send the request again.
